s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) I am Tala. (pause) Yesterday we talked about you and your family. (pause) Today, we get ready for school!
words: Every morning, we do five things. (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap each picture and say the words with me!
words-1: Wake up. (pause) We open our eyes.
words-2: Take a bath. (pause) We use soap and water.
words-3: Get dressed. (pause) We put on our clothes.
words-4: Eat breakfast. (pause) Our first food of the day.
words-5: Brush your teeth. (pause) Clean and shiny!
act: Let us play! (pause) Stand up. (pause) I say the words. (pause) You act them out!
act-1: Wake up! (pause) Stretch your arms up high!
act-2: Take a bath! (pause) Scrub, scrub, scrub!
act-5: Brush your teeth! (pause) Up and down, up and down.
find: Now, listen carefully. (pause) I say a word. (pause) You tap the right picture.
find-q1: Where is brush teeth? Tap it!
find-q2: Where is eat breakfast? Tap it!
find-q3: Where is take a bath? Tap it!
story1: Story time! (pause) Our story is called, Before Going to School. (pause) This is Tala and Bunso. (pause) They wake up early. (pause) It is time for school!
story2: Nanay says, hurry up! (pause) They take a bath. (pause) They get dressed. (pause) They eat breakfast. (pause) Then they brush their teeth.
mid-q1: After the bath, what did they do?
mid-q1-yes: Yes! They got dressed for school. (pause) Let us see what happens next!
story3: But wait. (pause) Oh no! (pause) Bunso's pencil is missing! (pause) Tala's crayons are missing! (pause) Where can they be?
story4: Nanay says, I will help you look. (pause) They look here. They look there. (pause) Look! Under the bed! (pause) Thank you, Nanay!
order: What happened in the story? (pause) Tap the pictures in order. (pause) First. (pause) Next. (pause) Last.
order-1: First, they got ready for school.
order-2: Next, the pencil and crayons were missing.
order-3: Last, they found them under the bed!
order-yes: First, next, last! (pause) You told the whole story!
who: Let us think about the story.
who-q1: Who helped Tala and Bunso look for their things?
who-q1-yes: Yes! Nanay helped them. (pause) Our family helps us.
who-q2: Where were the pencil and crayons?
who-q2-yes: Yes! They were under the bed!
my-morning: Now, let us talk about you! (pause) What do you do in the morning? (pause) Tap one. Then say it with me.
my-morning-1: In the morning, I wake up.
my-morning-2: In the morning, I take a bath.
my-morning-3: In the morning, I eat breakfast.
my-morning-4: In the morning, I brush my teeth.
talk: Tell me about your morning. (pause) Say: First, I wake up. (pause) Next, I eat breakfast. (pause) Your turn!
talk-example: First, I wake up. Next, I eat breakfast.
verse: Our Bible verse is, (pause) Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Honor means we listen to them. (pause) And we say thank you, like Tala and Bunso!
verse-verse: Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Exodus twenty, verse twelve.
done: Hooray! (pause) You learned five morning words. (pause) You told the story in order. (pause) And you talked about your morning. (pause) See you tomorrow!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
